source_reason: create a calendar、 create a page可以同时完成
interpretation: 按“calendar与page可同时完成”将原版主agent直接外写改为两个external writer并行；原版已有事件侧原生并行，不将其描述为原先完全串行。

changes.original: use exactly one sub-agent wave because the 504-row incident scan is the only data-heavy branch.
changes.replacement: keep the 504-row incident scan and workbook in one office writer, then give the independent dashboard and calendar outputs separate external writers in a second parallel wave.
changes.explanation: 只扩展两个外部产物的owner，保留原504行分析owner。

changes.original: it directly creates or updates exactly one page titled `Service Monitoring Dashboard - March 2026` and natively parallelizes exact event lookups/creates
changes.replacement: 2. Wave 2 — dispatch exactly 2 coder sub-agents together in parallel:
changes.explanation: 将page/calendar明确分给不同external角色，作为共享分析之后并行的独立输出。

changes.original: After one page/event read-back, send exactly one email
changes.replacement: Only after both Wave 2 handoffs return and the main agent confirms one complete dashboard and full required event coverage, send exactly one email
changes.explanation: 主agent汇总两个writer回执后发送，避免通知先于实际完成。

preserved_requirements: 全部504条、三服务，up/total*100一位、平均响应两位；连续down/degraded合并及时间戳时长。
Excel先完成，之后page/calendar并行；page含所有服务及具体事故窗。
仅有down检查的服务建2026-03-07 10:00–10:30事件，degraded-only不触发。
指定sender/recipient/subject；只列uptime<99%服务；保留所有无关内容。
assumptions: 将“可以同时完成”实现为独立子agent对照，而非仅重述原版主agent可原生并行。
plan_summary: Wave1单office作者完成扫描和Excel，返回紧凑行数据。
主agent冻结结果，Wave2两个external作者并行写dashboard和calendar。
主agent等待双方验证回执后发唯一邮件并验收。
expected_tradeoff: 独立writer可能缩短两个外部系统的并行路径，但增加派发及回执成本；原版已支持原生并行，收益需实测。
